verdict.rationale: Firebase documents Cloud Storage as a first-party product. Firebase Security Rules explicitly cover Cloud Storage and can use Authentication for user-based permissions (docs-10, docs-18, docs-32, docs-47), and a community user confirms working with storage rules (comm-9). Cloud Storage also appears in the Local Emulator Suite and as a Cloud Functions trigger source (docs-24, docs-29). However, the pack never describes the actual upload/download flows or any CDN-backed delivery of stored files. Missing for 10: documented user file upload and serving APIs, evidence of CDN-backed delivery for stored files, independent hands-on corroboration of storage serving.
